x-m-m3-09.prereq.0: Ukuba i-engile ebhalwe esangqeni ye-arc yingqukuva yengxenye ye-engile ephakathi ye-arc leyo
x-m-m3-09.s.s1.prompt: Umfundi othile wathi, "I-engile ephakathi yi-100°, ngoko nokuba C ikuphi esangqeni, ∠ACB ihlala i-50°." Wolugweba njani olu tshixo?
x-m-m3-09.s.s1.hint.0: Maka ichaphaza elinye C kwi-arc enkulu nelinye kwi-arc encinci, uthelekise ukuba ∠ACB ijonge eyiphi i-arc kwimeko nganye.
x-m-m3-09.s.s1.hint.1: Khangela ukuba 'i-engile ebhalwe esangqeni ye-arc' yi-engile ebonwa ukusuka kwichaphaza elisecaleni elichaseneyo ne-arc leyo.
x-m-m3-09.s.s1.o.a: Kunjalo. I-engile ebhalwe esangqeni yingqukuva yengxenye ye-engile ephakathi, ngoko i-50° yonke indawo
x-m-m3-09.s.s1.r.a: Ukuze ibe 'yingxenye ye-engile ephakathi,' kufuneka ukhangele ukuba i-engile ebhalwe esangqeni ijonge eyiphi i-arc. Jonga ukuba i-arc ejongwayo itshintsha na ngokwendawo yechaphaza C.
x-m-m3-09.s.s1.o.b: Hayi. Njengoko C isondela ku-A okanye ku-B, ∠ACB iyaqhubeka iba nkulu okanye incinci, ngoko akukho xabiso elimiselweyo
x-m-m3-09.s.s1.r.b: Ngoxa C ihamba kwi-arc enye, ∠ACB ayitshintshi. Ixabiso litshintsha xa i-arc itshintsha.
x-m-m3-09.s.s1.o.c: Hayi. ∠ACB inokwahluka ngokuxhomekeke ekubeni C ikwi-arc yeyiphi yesangqa
x-m-m3-09.s.s1.r.c: Ukrokrelele imeko apho i-arc ejongwa yi-engile ebhalwe esangqeni ixhomekeke kwindawo yechaphaza. Ngoku kufuneka ufumane onke amaxabiso anokwenzeka.
x-m-m3-09.s.s1.o.d: Kunjalo. ∠AOB ne-∠ACB zijonga amachaphaza amabini afanayo A no-B, ngoko zihlala zifana ne-100°
x-m-m3-09.s.s1.r.d: I-engile ebhalwe esangqeni ne-engile ephakathi zinobungakanani obahlukileyo kwi-arc enye. Ukujonga amachaphaza amabini afanayo akuzenzi zilingane ngobukhulu.
